title: Lower bound from uniform excess
statement: Let $V$ be a finite nonempty set, and let $p:V\to\mathbb{Q}$ satisfy $\sum_{u\in V}p(u)=1$. Define the uniform excess to be $\max_{u\in V}\bigl(p(u)-1/|V|\bigr)$. Then, for every $v\in V$, $1/|V|-|V|\max_{u\in V}\bigl(p(u)-1/|V|\bigr)\le p(v)$.
